Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied the core criterion of conserving natural resources by selecting “donate a new television” (which requires manufacturing a new unit and thus consumes resources) over “repair your broken television,” which directly extends the product’s life and avoids new manufacturing. The Planner also prematurely concluded the task without systematically evaluating options against the conservation goal, leading to an incorrect final answer.
